verdict.rationale: Three.js documents a WebGL renderer for today's browsers. It also ships a WebGPU renderer in its current builds, and TSL shaders target both backends, which makes the WebGPU story credible. Nothing in the evidence addresses payload or bundle size, so the 'reasonable payload' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: any evidence on bundle size or tree-shaking, WebGPU maturity or fallback behavior beyond the docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of WebGPU in shipped games.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story
